mapper.insert: insert into "h_churn_result" (model_id, churn_rate, top1_reason, top2_reason, top3_reason) values (#{modelId}, #{churnRate}, #{top1Reason}, #{top2Reason}, #{top3Reason})
mapper.select:
select r.result_id, r.model_id, r.churn_rate, r.top1_reason, r.top2_reason, r.top3_reason from "h_churn_result" r
join "h_model_data" m ON r.model_id = m.model_id join "h_member" mem ON m.username = mem.username where mem.gym_id = #{gymId}
